subject: Request: Personnel training & background evidence snapshot
messages:
From: Lisa Moran <lisa.moran@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2-audit@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Personnel evidence request for upcoming SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for making time last week. As we prepare for the BlueHarbor vendor SIG / SOC2 review (week of 4/18), the audit team asked for a compact personnel evidence snapshot focused on training, background checks, and onboarding/offboarding controls. Could you please provide the following by 4/11 so we can include it in our packet?

1) A CSV roster of employees with completed security training dates and course ids (redacted PII ok).
2) A redacted summary of background check completion for hires in the last 24 months (names can be replaced with employee IDs).
3) A machine-readable export (or plain text log) of onboarding and offboarding events for the last 90 days (user created/disabled timestamps, role changes).
4) Short notes on your redaction/playback process and who approved the artifacts.

Attachments: none from our side.

If you prefer, we can accept staged uploads to a shared Drive link and follow up with a short confirmation call.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation of scope and timeline.

Lisa Moran
Vendor Risk Manager
BlueHarbor Health
lisa.moran@blueharborhealth.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Moran <lisa.moran@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Personnel evidence request for upcoming SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a staged package by 4/11. Proposed plan:

- Monica (HR) will produce the redacted background-check summary (names -> employee IDs) and the onboarding/offboarding event log (90d).
- I will export the training roster (CSV) with course IDs and completion dates and include a short notes doc that explains our redaction process and approvals.
- Aditya will confirm the export format for the event log to ensure timestamps and role-change events are included.

We will deliver on Google Drive and add a short readme. Expected artifacts: training_roster_Q1_2027.csv, redacted_bg_checks_summary.pdf, onboard_offboard_events_90d.log, redaction_notes.txt.

Are those acceptable formats? If so, Monica and I will start prepping and I will share the Drive link by EOD 4/06 for initial review.

Attachments: none (will share Drive).

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Moran <lisa.moran@blueharborhealth.com>, SOC2 Audit Team <soc2-audit@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Personnel evidence request for upcoming SIG/SOC2 review

Hi all — looping in HR delivery. Confirming the artifacts and timeline below (per Hannah):

- redacted_bg_checks_summary.pdf (names replaced with stable employee IDs; includes check date, scope: criminal/identity/education, and vendor reference).
- training_roster_Q1_2027.csv (columns: employee_id, course_id, completion_date, certificate_id where applicable).
- onboard_offboard_events_90d.log (entries: timestamp, employee_id, event_type [onboard/offboard/role_change], actor).
- redaction_notes.txt (who redacted, method, approval ticket).

We will redact PII per our standard: replace names with internal IDs, strip SSNs and DOBs, and summarize results (pass/fail/exception with vendor ticket). Legal reviewed the package and approved redactions for third-party sharing under our DPA. Delivery plan: initial upload to shared Drive (link below) by EOD 4/06, final QA and signature bundle by 4/09.

Drive (staging): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink

Attachments (preview): training_roster_Q1_2027.csv (stub), redacted_bg_checks_summary.pdf (stub).

Monica Patel
People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Lisa Moran <lisa.moran@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2-audit@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Personnel evidence request for upcoming SIG/SOC2 review

Monica / Hannah —

Thanks, this looks good. Two quick clarifications before you finalize the upload:

1) Can the onboarding/offboarding log include the source of the event (e.g., HR console, SCIM connector, admin API)? Our audit needs to see how events are generated.
2) For background checks, please include vendor reference IDs and the date the vendor delivered the final report (even if redacted).

If those items are in the staging upload I can mark the packet as complete. I confirm the Drive link is acceptable. Once the staging package is uploaded we may request a short 20-min call to walk through the artifacts.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aiming to finalize on 4/11.

Thanks,
Lisa Moran
Vendor Risk Manager
BlueHarbor Health

Attachments: none
